title: Engineering Development Engine tool manifest
description: Machine-readable tool registry derived from MASTER.md section 24. Describes tools and HOW to detect them; must never assert installation state (runtime detection results live in environment.json, produced by PEM).

tool.description: One registered tool. Field names follow MASTER.md section 24.

required.description: Whether the platform requires this tool.

min_version.description: Minimum acceptable version, or null when UNKNOWN (never guessed).

preferred_version.description: Preferred/validated version, or null when UNKNOWN.

detection_method.description: How PEM should probe for this tool (T-0102). 'none' = in-house or not yet detectable.

executable.description: Executable/command name to probe, or null when not applicable.

items.description: id of another tool in this manifest.

installation_method.description: How the tool is (or will be) installed; null when in-house/not applicable. Must not claim automation that does not exist.

health_check.description: Command that verifies the tool runs, or null when not applicable.

capability.description: Capabilities this tool serves (MASTER section 22 capability list).

notes.description: Provenance/justification for version choices or other caveats.
